handback.title: Cards stop looking up old work branches and worker runs
handback.summary: Cards and agents stop asking GitHub about old work branches and old worker runs.
handback.user_story: Each card redraw asks GitHub only about branches and runs that still exist.

acceptance_criteria.text: Finding an issue's pull requests no longer looks up its old work branch.

edge_cases.case: An issue whose only pull request sits on the old work branch shows none.

acceptance_criteria.text: Finding an issue's pull requests still finds the one on its try branch.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Only the try branch is left to look up; nothing else changes.

acceptance_criteria.text: The card no longer finds its issue from an old worker run's title.

edge_cases.case: A finished run with no pull request finds no issue.

acceptance_criteria.text: Redrawing a card no longer asks GitHub for old worker runs.
acceptance_criteria.words: worker.yml no longer exists, so this is a wasted API call on every redraw.

edge_cases.case: A card with no latest run still draws.

acceptance_criteria.text: Tests that only check the deleted code are deleted too.
acceptance_criteria.words: Delete it, plus the tests that only exercise it.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: This plan makes those test changes itself; the check guards them.

acceptance_criteria.text: A pull request on an old work branch no longer names its issue by branch.

edge_cases.case: A pull request on the try branch still names its issue.

test_changes.tests/test_body.py::run_card: Stops patching the deleted worker run lookup.
test_changes.tests/test_card_records.py::write_main: Stops patching the deleted worker run lookup.
test_changes.tests/test_card_records.py::fake_github: Stops serving old worker runs, so asking for them fails.
test_changes.tests/test_card_records.py::test_the_car: Checks only the try branch, for both lookups; proves 763.2.
test_changes.tests/test_card_status.py::fake_github: Stops serving old worker runs, so asking for them fails.
test_changes.tests/card_player.py::worker_finished: Deleted: it only played an old worker run finishing; nothing used it.
